name: Mechanic
tagline: Twelve years keeping Harrow Transit's buses alive.
description: Twelve years on the night shift at Depot 3. Good with tools, better with engines, and never throws a part away.

perk.name: Grease Monkey
perk.description: Repairs cost half the materials and wear the item half as much. Crafting takes 40% less time, and you get the ambulance running three times faster.

ability.name: Noise-maker
ability.description: Throw a rattling, beeping decoy at the cursor. It pulls every walker in earshot for ten seconds.

names.ruth_deal_intro: Teodor says you fix buses for a living. Then I have a deal for you.
names.ambulance_quip: Twelve years of buses, and this is the engine that matters.

name: Paramedic
tagline: Six years on a county ambulance, lights and sirens.
description: You rode with a partner named Dee until the dispatch radio went quiet. You know a wound, you know a pharmacy, and you keep your head.

perk.name: First Responder
perk.description: Healing items restore 50% more health, and infections progress 40% slower.

ability.name: Adrenaline Shot
ability.description: Restores 30 health, refills stamina, and for eight seconds sprinting, swinging and shoving cost nothing.

names.ruth_deal_intro: Teodor says you drove an ambulance for the county. Then I have a deal you'll like.
names.ambulance_quip: Same model you drove for the county. The jump seat even has the same coffee stain.

name: Ex-cop
tagline: Nine years in a Harrow PD patrol car.
description: You walked away from the force the spring before the outbreak. You still keep the service pistol clean and the safety on.

perk.name: Range Time
perk.description: Firearms do 15% more damage, reload 25% faster and spread 20% less.

ability.name: Flashbang
ability.description: Throw a stun grenade at the cursor. Zombies near the blast are dazed for three seconds. Loud.

names.sam_job: a Harrow PD patrol officer until last spring
names.pike_greeting: My favorite cop. Never thought I'd say that.
names.ruth_deal_intro: Teodor says you were a cop. I won't hold it against you. I have a deal for you.
names.ambulance_quip: You check the mirrors out of habit. Nobody's following. Nobody's left to.

name: Scavenger
tagline: Paid the rent selling what the city threw away.
description: Estate sales, dumpsters, foreclosed houses. You know where people hide things, and how to get in quietly.

perk.name: Light Fingers
perk.description: Searching takes 35% less time, your footsteps are 25% quieter, and containers hold an extra find more often.

ability.name: Scout
ability.description: For eight seconds, see unsearched containers and zombies within 20 tiles, even through walls.

names.sam_job: a picker who made rent selling what the city threw away
names.ruth_deal_intro: Teodor says you can find anything in this city. Then find me two things.
names.ambulance_quip: Not bad for a pile of parts out of other people's cars.
